6034.title: Browser ownership is absent from the verification inventory
6034.rootCauseOneLine: CLI discovery includes browser.ts, but the explicit CLI owner table has no browser entry, so collection aborts before fingerprint comparison.
6034.proposedFix: Assign the existing desktop recipe owner to the browser family, document its CLI and SDK recipes, and cover accepted ownership, drift and fail-closed missing recipes with focused fixture tests.
6034.caveats: The browser-only repair reveals a separate unmapped diagnostics family. No real-checkout fingerprints were accepted; native browser recipes remain not run. Reproduction code and output are inline because the reports repository forbids artifact directories.
